title: Vault: TLS listener cert rotation (standbys first, active last)
description: Runs `nexus cert-rotate vault --yes`. Re-issues each node's listener cert from pki_int/issue/vault-server and SIGHUP-reloads it. Standbys are rotated FIRST and the active node LAST so the cluster never loses its leader; 0 errors in ~16.8s.

observe.what: each listener cert re-issued from pki_int/issue/vault-server, SIGHUP reload; standbys rotated FIRST, active LAST; new serial per node; 0 errors in ~16.8s

whatProves: VaultAdapter.CertRotateAsync re-issues each node's listener certificate from pki_int/issue/vault-server and SIGHUP-reloads it, ordering standbys first and the active node last so the cluster keeps its leader throughout (0 errors, ~16.8s).
